title: Finding a Job
summary: Гэр бүлдээ мөнгө олохын тулд ресторанд ажилд орохыг хичээсэн Алишагийн түүх.

source.name: LIDA Stories
source.credit: Written by Espen Stranger-Johannessen, illustrated by Sunniva Høiby-Øiset · LIDA Stories

changes: Images and audio removed; the picture-book pages were joined into paragraphs (one page per paragraph, with very short pages of the same scene merged).

questions.prompt: What is the story mainly about?
options: How Alisha gets a job in a restaurant
How Alisha opens her own restaurant
How Alisha finds a school for her children
questions.explain: Алиша сургалтад суугаад дараагийн ярилцлага дээр "she is offered the job" буюу ажилд орсон.

questions.prompt: Why did Alisha not get the first job?
options: She had not trained as a chef.
She could not use the Internet.
She did not want to work evenings.
questions.explain: Менежер нь "they need someone who has trained as a chef" гэж хэлсэн. Алиша тогоочоор сурч байгаагүй.

options: A list of your work and your courses
A course about food and cooking
A job advert on the Internet
questions.explain: Текстэд "A CV is a description of all the work she has done and all the courses she has taken" гэж тайлбарласан.
